subject: maths
question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 250. It is sold for Rs. 164.70 after giving three successive discounts of 20%, 10% and x% on the marked price. What is the value of x?
solution:
Calculation:

Selling price of 20% discount = 0.8 × Rs 250 = Rs 200

Selling price of 10% discount = 0.9 × Rs 200 = Rs 180

Total discount given = Rs 180 - Rs 164.70 = Rs 15.3

Discount % = 15.3over180 × 100 = 8.5.%

∴ The value of x is 8.5%.
